 Davis Daniel (KT Wiz) showed off the dignity of the wizard corps ace.
 Danyel took the mound as KT's starting pitcher in Game 1 of the 2026 KBO Korean Series (KS, best-of-seven) against the Samsung Lions at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 3rd.
 KT won the regular league championship with 90 wins, 5 draws and 49 losses and went straight to KS. Those who took a break for about three weeks after the end of the regular season are aiming for their first unified championship in five years since 2021.
 사진 확대 Game 1 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the afternoon of the 3rd. KT starter Daniel is pitching hard. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan 사진 확대 Game 1 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 3rd. KT Daniel is making a high-five after the sixth inning. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan In the previous KS, the winning team of the first round has a whopping 73.8% (31/42). The team that rings the victory on this day can get closer to the KS championship trophy.
 In this situation, KT selected Daniel as the starting pitcher. Danyel, who joined Matt Sauer during the season as an alternative foreign player, is a right-hander who has won 5-2 with a 2.13 ERA in 10 games (55 innings) this year. In particular, it was strong in Suwon, where the first round of KS was played. In five games, he played a salty game with an ERA of 1.16. This is my first meeting with Samsung.
 Before the game, KT manager Lee Kang-chul expected good pitching, saying, "I just hope that the starting pitcher (Daniel) will block it well."
 The beginning was unsettling. In the top of the first inning, Kim Ji-chan, the leadoff hitter, hit an infield single to shortstop. He then gave up a long-shot hit to Park Seung-gyu, but the ball was sucked into the glove of center fielder Sam Hilliard, who attempted a jump catch. Danyel, who felt lighter, led Koo Ja-wook to strike out. Immediately after, catcher Han Seung-taek caught Kim Ji-chan, who was attempting to steal second base, and the inning ended as it was.
 At the beginning of the second inning, I found stability. Lewin Diaz and Choi Hyung-woo were guided to second base ground balls side by side. Kim Young-woong was allowed a hit to the middle, but Ryu Ji-hyuk was tied up with a fly to shortstop. In the top of the third inning, Kang Min-ho (three strikeouts), Lee Jae-hyun (third baseman groundout), and Kim Ji-chan (pitcher groundout) were put to rest, creating his first three-out inning of the day. After that, he also finished with three batters in the top of the fourth inning: Park Seung-gyu (three strikeouts), Koo Ja-wook (ground ball to the first baseman), and Diaz (left-handed fly).
 사진 확대 Game 1 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the afternoon of the 3rd. KT starter Daniel is pitching hard. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan The stability continued in the top of the fifth inning. He defeated Choi Hyung-woo (three strikeouts), Kim Young-woong (striker straight hit), and Ryu Ji-hyuk (three strikeouts). In the top of the sixth inning, he then overpowered Kim Heon-gon (three strikeouts), Lee Jae-hyun (three strikeouts), and Kim Ji-chan (a groundout to second baseman).
 The loss came in the top of the seventh inning. After allowing Park Seung-gyu to hit left-handed, he donated a two-run shot to Koo Ja-wook with a driving distance of 125 meters. Later, when Diaz also received a hit to the right, the KT bench replaced the pitcher with left-hander Logan Allen. Logan gave up a home run to the successor, and the total earned run remained at three points.
 The final result was five hits, one homer, seven strikeouts, and three runs in six innings. The total number of pitches was 84. KT is leading 8-3 as of the top of the seventh inning with Daniel's good pitching.
 사진 확대 Game 1 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 3rd. KT starter Daniel is going down the mound in the top of the seventh inning. [Lee Hanjoo, MK Sports Reporter]
